Build and drive execution of infrastructure migration plans, including data center, network, cloud, telephony, and end-user computing migrations. Lead cross-functional workstream leads and third-party integration partners/systems integrators to deliver against the integration master schedule. TSA MANAGEMENT Own the technology components of Transition Services Agreements (TSAs), ensuring services provided by or to the seller are scoped, resourced, and delivered per agreed terms. Track TSA exit criteria and timelines, proactively managing dependencies to ensure timely separation and full exit from seller-owned or shared systems and infrastructure. Negotiate TSA scope, cost, and extension requests in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development, escalating risks that threaten exit deadlines. Manage vendor and service provider relationships required to stand up replacement capabilities ahead of TSA expiration.
